title: Supervisor: caps on budget, turns and wall clock
epic: E0.5 Adapter contract and first vendor
description: Wrap any adapter run in a supervisor that enforces dollar, turn and wall-clock caps and kills the process tree on breach.
acceptance: A fake runaway process is killed within 2 s of the wall-clock cap
Breach is recorded as cap_breach with which cap
No orphan child processes remain (checked via process listing)
